options.fade.operation_mode.tooltip:
Normal: Hides nearby entities to clear your vision and improve performance.
Optimize: Hides distant entities to maximize performance.
(⚠️ For both modes, 'Vanish' provides the best optimization, while 'Fade' still improves performance but is slightly less effective.)
options.fade.custom_targets.tooltip: Even in Fade mode, items will vanish completely instead of becoming semi-transparent.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.fade: Hides entities within a specific block range.
options.fade.fade_item_as_vanish.tooltip: When enabled, item entities will completely vanish instead of fading out to maintain maximum performance. When disabled, items remain fully visible on the ground.
